title: Waypoint storage bounds 32/256 and 5.03 waypoint_limit diagnostic (spec 18.3.2)
description: Spec 12-apps.md 18.3.2: Implementations MUST bound waypoint storage to at most 32 waypoints per originator IID and 256 waypoints globally, and POST to a full table MUST return 5.03 Service Unavailable with CBOR diagnostic {reason: waypoint_limit, per_originator: 32, global: 256}. Classification: divergent. Evidence: C LICHEN_WAYPOINT_MAX 8U flat, no per-originator tracking (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/include/lichen/coap_waypoints.h:16, full-check coap_waypoints.c:298), bare 5.03 with NULL payload (coap_waypoints.c:994-998); Python _WAYPOINTS_MAX 100 flat with silent oldest-eviction, no 5.03 (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/waypoints.py:16,119-125); Rust client-only (rust/lichen-client/src/waypoint.rs). Strings waypoint_limit/per_originator appear only in the spec. Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_waypoints.c (per-originator accounting + structured 5.03 body), python/src/lichen/coap/resources/waypoints.py (bounds + 5.03), test/vectors/waypoint.json (new limit vectors). Refs R-12-029, R-12-030.
